description: FamilySearch tree person read for Thomas Flynn (LZNY-TF1), Patrick Flynn's father, for search-hints' thin-evidence test (ut_search_hints_003). It mirrors mid-research-flynn's tree person I2: born ~1818 in Ireland, nothing else, so it neither confirms nor contradicts the 1856 naturalization hint. search-hints step 3 compares a hint to the tree person and reads person_read when it cannot match the FamilySearch id to a project tree person; mid-research-flynn's persons carry no ark, so that read is legitimate and this fixture answers it. Same shape as person-read-flynn: persons/relationships/sources, the ark person_read always emits, both date and place sidecars. The predicate is personId alone.
